name: DELIGNIT AG  INH.O.N.
summary: Delignit AG develops, manufactures, and sells ecological and wood-based materials and system solutions based on natural, renewable, and CO2 neutral raw material wood in Germany. The company offers manufacture and sale of cargo bay protection systems and security systems; original equipment manufacturers: retrofit equipment; cargo bay; floors, walls, and partition walls; cabinet systems; and trunk covers for light commercial vehicles, motor caravans, and passenger cars. It also provides flooring solutions for automotive manufacturing plants, as well as for goods distribution centers; beech-based plywood; highly and medium compressed materials that are used in plant construction, machine construction, and transformer construction applications; and manufactures rail vehicles with floor system solutions for fire protection and sound insulation concepts Delignit AG offers its products and solutions under the Delignit, VANYCARE, Carbonwood, Dunacore, Feinholz, Festholz, and Panzerholz brand names. The company was founded in 1799 and is based in Blomberg, Germany.
